problem:
Given the orthogonal basis $B$ of ${R}^{3}$ and the vector $x$ below, find the value of $29{x}_{1}$, where ${x}_{1}$ is the first component of $[x]_{B}.$

$$
B={[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 4 \\ -2\end{aligned}],[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -3 \\ -3\end{aligned}],[\begin{aligned}-18 \\ 5 \\ -17\end{aligned}]},\,x=[\begin{aligned}5 \\ -1 \\ 2\end{aligned}]
$$
